body: BLOCK exact 609e35f with two P1s. First, declaration regex misses qualified-private and abstract/open forms; realistic modified API fixtures with surviving consumers return no types / exit 0. Second, consumer search ignores .js/.native roots, so a modified shared API with an unchanged JS-only downstream consumer emits only coreJVM/test instead of refusing or gating that platform. Repair modifier recognition and platform-consumer discovery/fail-closed behavior. Evidence posts post-01M1CF1N3B5SZC7RR5RCE1HRDB and post-01M1CF8DZGQ2ZM0NZF0PE7QFW2.
